analytic_check_of_adjudicator_universal_.purpose: Parent-requested manual check of the adjudicator’s general assertion; not graded critic evidence and not a replacement credited to P31.
analytic_check_of_adjudicator_universal_.assumptions: Keep P=<(12)> and H=<(13)> for this check of the ADJ narrative. Examine g_alt=(23)(12)=(132), another representative of the H-fixed coset (23)P.
analytic_check_of_adjudicator_universal_.forward: g_alt(13)g_alt^{-1}=(g_alt(1) g_alt(3))=(3 2)=(23), which is not in P.
analytic_check_of_adjudicator_universal_.reverse: g_alt^{-1}=(123), so g_alt^{-1}(13)g_alt=(2 1)=(12), which is in P.
analytic_check_of_adjudicator_universal_.fixedness: The reverse membership implies (13)g_alt P=g_alt P; together with the identity element this shows that H fixes the coset.
analytic_check_of_adjudicator_universal_.conclusion: For the same named H and fixed coset, g=(23) gives the ADJ’s true reversed membership, whereas g_alt=(132) gives false membership. Testing one representative cannot support the asserted conclusion for all representatives.
analytic_check_of_adjudicator_universal_.grade_effect: None. The saved response supplied g=(123) and h=(23), not g_alt=(132) and h_alt=(13); its original h is not in its original H and its original gP is not H-fixed. Source-scope INVALID still follows.
